title: Ionic Wealth raises Rs 177 Cr from Angel One, marquee families
description:
Ionic Wealth, the wealth-tech platform backed by Angel One, has raised Rs 177 crore in a strategic funding round led by Angel One and marquee families.
The latest fundraise takes the company’s cumulative capital raised to around Rs 466 crore.

title: Boba Bhai raises $18 Mn from Left Lane, Titan and BIG Capital
description:
Bubble tea and Korean street food brand Boba Bhai has raised $18 million in its Series B funding round with participation from US-based Left Lane Capital and BIG Capital, along with existing investor Titan Capital.
The round marks Left Lane Capital’s entry into the company, while BIG Capital has increased its investment. The proceeds will be used to expand Boba Bhai’s store network across India and launch new brands under Boba Bhai Ventures.

title: Style Union raises Rs 485 Cr in Series E round led by Elev8 Venture, Venturi Partners
description:
Nexon Omniverse, the parent company of value fashion retailer Style Union, has raised Rs 485 crore (approximately $52 million) in a Series E funding round led by Venturi Partners and co-led by Elev8 Venture Partners. The round comprises a mix of primary and secondary capital.

title: Physical AI startup Humyn Labs raises $47 Mn in equity and debt
description:
Bengaluru-based Humyn Labs has raised $47 million in a Series A round comprising equity and debt. The round includes $26 million in equity and $21 million in venture debt.
According to the press release, Accel led the equity round, which also saw participation from Prosus Ventures, BeeGlobal, Finserv Intelligence through Bajaj Finance, Bajaj Alts AI Opportunities Fund, Dallas Venture Capital, Lighthouse Canton, Jump Trading, and angel investor Anita Pramoda, former CFO of Epic.

title: Fatehpuria Hygiene raises Rs 100 Cr in maiden equity round led by Madhu Kela
description:
Fatehpuria Hygiene, a trade, supply chain and fulfilment company, has raised Rs 100 crore in its maiden equity funding round led by investor Madhu Kela.
The proceeds will be used to expand its presence across more than 50 major cities over the next 24 months and build an AI-enabled supply chain network, the company said in a press release.

title: Egg brand Henfruit raises $15 Mn from Lok Capital, DSG and RPSG Capital
description:
Branded egg company Henfruit has raised $15 million in a Series A funding round led by Lok Capital, DSG Consumer Partners and RPSG Capital Ventures.
The fundraise marks the company’s first external investment since its inception in 2014. Henfruit operated as a bootstrapped business for over a decade.

title: Urban Company opens Rs 2,500 Cr QIP, sets floor price at Rs 161.03 per share
description:
Gurugram-based home services platform Urban Company has opened its qualified institutional placement (QIP) to raise funds from institutional investors, setting the floor price at Rs 161.03 per equity share.
In a regulatory filing, the company said its fundraise committee approved the opening of the issue on November 16, along with the preliminary placement document.

title: AI CRM startup Dreamteam raises $53 Mn from Accel, Premji Invest, others
description:
AI-native CRM startup Dreamteam has raised $53 million in a funding round with participation from Together Fund, Accel and Premji Invest.
Headquartered in California, the company plans to extend its platform to other stages of the customer lifecycle, including prospecting, onboarding, customer success and upselling.

title: Bharat Semi raises $24 Mn in seed round from Info Edge, South Park Common, others
description:
Semiconductor startup Bharat Semi has raised $24 million in a seed funding round led by Info Edge Group, South Park Commons and Indus Bridge Ventures. The round also saw participation from Micromax, Valour Capital, New York-based Gaingels and angel investors Mukul Agarwal and Karthik Sundar Iyer.
The fresh capital will be used to accelerate product development, expand its engineering teams in the US and strengthen its go-to-market efforts with global customers.

title: Paytm shares near IPO price amid MDR rollout and 6 consecutive profitable quarters
description:
Shares of One 97 Communications, the parent company of Paytm, have been gradually moving closer to their initial public offering (IPO) price of Rs 2,150 over the past few months, supported by improving financial performance and a positive regulatory development. title: Greenjoules raises Rs 150 Cr in Series B led by Amazon funds, secures Rs 100 Cr loan from TDB
description:
Pune-based renewable fuels startup Greenjoules has raised Rs 150 crore in a Series B funding round co-led by Amazon’s Smbhav Venture Fund and Climate Pledge Fund.
The round also saw participation from Rainmatter, the investment arm of Zerodha, and Singularity’s Strategic Autonomy Fund. Blue Ashva Capital, which led the company’s Series A round in 2021, remains its largest shareholder.
Separately, Greenjoules has secured a Rs 100 crore loan from the Technology Development Board
